style: generated_v2: video-based (Grok Imagine I2V) with baked bounce/secondary motion, canonical_ko look
jiggle_note: All clips are tagged baked_motion: the engine must damp chest/pigtail springs and breathing for them (AnimatorConfig::baked_motion_gain in lillith-anim).
notes: Canonical set (committed 2026-10-20). idle = alias of idle_a; idle_a/idle_b are variant_of:idle for random cycling; idle_flirt_* carry idle_variant (pose-cycle mannerisms, not idle loops); finger_wag_tease, hands_behind_head_pose and bounce_giggle are aliases of near-duplicate clips. Batch 13: walk_sassy/skip/saunter_{right,left} (variant_of:walk_right|walk_left), sit_bored_chin/cross_legged_bob/heel_kick/stretch_yawn (variant_of:sit_swing; engine has no walk/sit variant picker yet) and idle_bored_sigh/nail_check/tail_fidget/yawn_stretch (variant_of:idle, idle_variant; ~4 s gesture loops).
